GO_TO_DISCOVERY.description: Market opportunity identified with preliminary evidence; ready for market discovery phase
GO_TO_DISCOVERY.next_phase: Customer interviews, market validation, competitive deep-dive

GO_TO_CUSTOMER_VALIDATION.description: Strong market evidence and multiple customer signals; ready for customer development
GO_TO_CUSTOMER_VALIDATION.next_phase: Customer advisory board, pilot engagement, competitive positioning

GO_TO_TECHNICAL_PROTOTYPE.description: Market and customer validation complete; ready for technical prototype

GO_TO_LEGAL_REVIEW.description: Strong market evidence but regulatory ambiguity; requires legal counsel before proceeding
GO_TO_LEGAL_REVIEW.next_phase: External legal counsel engagement, compliance pathway design

HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.description: Promising but insufficient evidence; hold pending research completion
HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.next_phase: Complete market research, regulatory assessment, competitive analysis

HOLD_FOR_DEPENDENCY.description: Viable model but depends on resolution of other models or external factors
criteria: Market exists but dependent on adjacent infrastructure
Regulatory approval contingent on other changes
HOLD_FOR_DEPENDENCY.next_phase: Resolve dependencies, then proceed to appropriate GO category

NO_GO_CURRENT_FORM.description: Market exists but business model as designed is not viable; consider pivot or abandon
criteria: TAM too small (<50M EUR) for sustainable business
NO_GO_CURRENT_FORM.next_phase: Explore model variations, consider pivots or archive

REJECTED.description: Market or regulatory conditions make this model non-viable
REJECTED.next_phase: Archive model, do not pursue further

market_sizing_validation.description: Is the market size accurate and verified?
checks: TAM value sourced from official statistics or multi-source research
Currency and base year clearly documented
market_sizing_validation.go_criteria: TAM VERIFIED or SUPPORTED with explicit sources
market_sizing_validation.hold_criteria: TAM ESTIMATED or INFERRED pending research

buyer_demand_validation.description: Are there actual signals of buyer demand?
buyer_demand_validation.go_criteria: Multiple demand signals from different sources
buyer_demand_validation.hold_criteria: Logical pain point but no actual customer signals yet
buyer_demand_validation.no_go_criteria: No evidence of active demand despite TAM

technical_feasibility_validation.description: Can this be technically built within reasonable timeframe and cost?
technical_feasibility_validation.hold_criteria: Technical path exists but requires validation
technical_feasibility_validation.no_go_criteria: Fundamental technical barriers or data unavailable

regulatory_feasibility_validation.description: Can this operate within regulatory framework?
regulatory_feasibility_validation.hold_criteria: Regulatory status ambiguous, requires legal review

cold_start_achievability_validation.hold_criteria: Bootstrap path exists but requires validation

data_availability_validation.go_criteria: Data availability confirmed or easily achievable
data_availability_validation.hold_criteria: Data sources identified but access pending

integration_complexity_validation.description: What is the realistic integration burden?
integration_complexity_validation.no_go_criteria: Integration complexity too high, excessive cost/time

preliminary_go_classification.title: Pflegeeinsatz und ambulante Dienste

critical_gaps: Specific care coordinator digital tool demand

preliminary_go_classification.title: Psychotherapie-Kapazitätsnetz

Primary blocking issue is regulatory ambiguity (telehealth therapy constraints). Legal review required before customer validation.

preliminary_go_classification.title: Zahnarzt Praxis Digitalisierung
preliminary_go_classification.rationale: Dental software 11% CAGR; USD 411.9M by 2030; AI in dentistry explosive (USD 516.5M→USD 3.9B); market emerging

batch_02_healthcare_diagnostics_oncology.preliminary_observations: Batch 2 heavily dependent on medical device regulation (MDR), complex integration with hospital systems, high regulatory burden. All models require legal review.

market_sizing_score.5: TAM VERIFIED from official statistics (EUR/USD with sources)
market_sizing_score.4: TAM SUPPORTED from 2+ market research sources

competitive_validation_score.5: Direct competitors identified with market share; clear differentiators
competitive_validation_score.3: Competitive landscape documented; differentiation needs refinement

regulatory_validation_score.5: Regulatory pathway clear; low/no licensing required
regulatory_validation_score.3: Regulated but pathway exists; legal review needed

technical_validation_score.5: Technology mature; data available; integration straightforward
technical_validation_score.4: Technology proven; data accessible; moderate integration

demand_validation_score.5: Multiple customer signals; active demand; RFP evidence
demand_validation_score.4: Strong pain point; customer demand likely
demand_validation_score.3: Pain point documented; customer demand assumed
demand_validation_score.2: Pain point logical; no customer signals yet
